eligibilitySummary.enUs: Available to overseas visitors buying tax-refundable goods at tax-free stores and leaving through eligible departure ports; refund-upon-purchase also requires an agreement and credit-card pre-authorisation, subject to official conditions.

sources.publisher: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China
sources.title: What is the Departure Tax Refund Policy?

observedFacts: Overseas visitors can obtain a VAT refund for tax-refundable goods purchased at tax-free stores when leaving China through eligible departure ports.
Overseas visitors include foreign nationals and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan residents who meet the stated mainland-residency condition.
Refund-upon-purchase stores require an agreement and credit-card pre-authorisation, while departure and designated-port conditions still apply.
limitations: The source applies to tax-free stores and eligible departure ports; it does not establish participation by every retailer.
Rolex retailer participation and any transaction-specific refund amount are not established by this evidence.
